name: Compressor
description: A gentle track compressor (D84): hard knee, peak detection, stereo-linked. Preview: Web Audio DynamicsCompressor (its automatic make-up gain cancelled); export: ffmpeg acompressor. Steady levels match; on speech and music the two detectors differ by up to about 1.5 dB, so keep ratios modest.
author: Biliup

thresholdDb.description: Level (dBFS) above which it compresses. Used within −60…0 (clamped; v0.1 had no range).

ratio.description: Input dB over the threshold per output dB. Used within 1–20 (clamped).

releaseMs.description: How fast it lets go (ms); at most 1000, the preview's DynamicsCompressor limit.
